answer: Each agent locks a 60-credit ferrous bond and must trade with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch at 6 each, so one fake identity costs 132 credits. A glacier rule counts a partner only after 5 epochs, blocking rented-partner rings. Auditors rebuild the vine graph each epoch; identities sharing over 4 partners both burn, so one set cannot serve a farm. Forging 1,000 identities costs 132,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once.
